subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept this coordinated 14-action update, including Codex Action's runner security setup and new code in secret-bearing token, release, and publishing workflows?
rationale: Static CI can verify workflow syntax and many checks, but it cannot decide whether the changed third-party runner and credential boundaries match the repository's intended security posture.

options.title: Approve the audited batch
options.body: Verify every immutable revision and the final exact-head privileged workflows, then approve the coordinated update as one dependency-maintenance change.

options.title: Split privileged updates
options.body: Separate Codex Action, GitHub App token, Docker publishing, and CodeQL revisions from routine toolchain setup updates for narrower security review.

options.title: Pause the batch
options.body: Keep the existing pins until the upstream security behavior or release-path validation can be established more confidently.

recommendation.title: Approve the audited batch
recommendation.body: Verify every immutable revision and the final exact-head privileged workflows, then approve the coordinated update as one dependency-maintenance change.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available owner for repository-wide release, CI, and protected workflow security decisions.
